name: Celio Delatorre
source:
President of the Knights College, as well as the professor in charge of lectures. He is a knowledgeable and educated man who has a lot to teach his students. However, there is also a side of him he never shows to others. He's taken particular interest in Argo and seems to look out for him.

Likes: Looking after plants, fieldwork.
Dislikes: Loud noises, Diederich's drinking habits.

[Based on [url=http://kaiju09.com/knights_college/english/]official character profile[/url].]
